description: FULL BODY. A Malaysian male in his late 30s, dressed in a formal Royal Malaysia Police (PDRM) dark blue uniform with professional insignia and a peaked cap. He has a clean-shaven, authoritative face and stands in a disciplined posture wearing polished black leather boots.

FULL BODY. An elderly Malaysian woman in her 60s, wearing a traditional Baju Kurung in soft lavender with a matching floral headscarf (tudung). She has a gentle, aged face and wears simple black sandals.

FULL BODY. An anonymous, featureless human silhouette made of glowing blue digital matrix code. The figure has a sleek, featureless head and wears a faint, translucent outline of a business suit to appear professional yet artificial.

FULL BODY. An anonymous, featureless human silhouette in deep charcoal gray, with circuit-board patterns etched into its surface. The figure is shaped like a person in formal attire but has no facial features, representing a digital deception.
